name: Typing trace
description: For finding what goes wrong while typing or selecting in the message box: while Record is on, every touch, focus change, selection change, keyboard input and keyboard opening or closing around the box is written down with its time, and saved to Settings › Advanced › Logs a moment after you stop. Off, it does nothing.

settings.label: Record
settings.description: Turn on, do the thing that goes wrong, wait two seconds, then open Settings › Advanced › Logs and copy the "Typing trace" entry.
